question: How many FreeCAD features store sub-element references as raw indices rather than mapped names?

scan_scope.note: reported per D-015: a survey that scanned nothing also finds nothing

raw_index_consumers.modern_equivalent: PartDesign::DressUp uses App::PropertyLinkSub Base - the mapped-name path

route_2_independent_confirmations.finding: PropertyFilletEdges::SaveDocFile writes `it.edgeid << it.radius1 << it.radius2` - an integer, no name. Read from the persistence path, not from the struct declaration.
P2 probe in the working Part build: shadow mapped name ';Face2;:Hce7,F.Face6' against a Part::Cut

51 .cpp files manipulate subnames, same order as the 55 class-uses. The only sub-element members outside the class list are Part::Attacher::subnames (populated from AttachmentSupport, a PropertyLinkSubList, and carrying shadowSubs) and Sketcher::ExternalToAdd::subname (a transient argument struct). No missed storage mechanism.

controls.negative: the method separates Part::Fillet (raw index, via SaveDocFile) from PartDesign::DressUp (PropertyLinkSub) - two cases known from round 007
controls.positive: P2 shows a non-empty mapped name where one is known to exist

coherence: 55 class-uses across ~48 Mod headers plus src/App; behaviour axis finds 51 files - same order. FilletBase has exactly 2 derivatives, matching the 2 raw-index features.
caveats: PartDesign classified by source reading only: it cannot be run in this configuration (0 of 20 tests pass).

Capability is not population: 48 headers CAN store mapped names. Whether they DO in a real model is not measured here, and round 007 found one case storing an empty one because the referenced feature was a primitive.
Expressions, spreadsheet references and the GUI layer are out of scope. So is Sketcher external geometry.
